Step A: Strict Payload & Magic-Byte Validation (validator.py)
• Verifies allowed MIME types (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp)
• Inspects file header magic bytes & enforces max file size limits (10 MB)
• Rejects corrupt, zero-byte, or non-image payloads before storage
Step B: EXIF Stripping & SHA-256 Content Hashing (sanitizer.py)
• Decodes via Pillow & strips EXIF/GPS/camera metadata (student privacy)
• Normalizes color space (RGB) & computes SHA-256 content hash
• Persists sanitized bytes to Private Cloud Storage Bucket via StorageBackend
Step C: Image Legibility & Quality Pre-Check (quality_service.py)
• Evaluates dimensions, aspect ratio, contrast & blur metrics
• Flags unreadable scans early & attaches quality metadata for Stage 1 AI
3. Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent Diagnostic & Cohort Intelligence Engine (services/worker)
Enforces CLASSLENS_AI_MODE=live + Secret Manager live-auth-key (Mock in CI)
• Sends sanitized worksheet bytes + assessment prompt & expected answer
• Extracts raw handwritten equations, unit-form text & crossed-out work
• Captures number-line start, directional arrows, jump ticks & landing marks
• Captures fraction tape/area model partitions, shading & confidence score
• Separates raw visual observation from diagnosis (zero premature labeling)
• Authenticated via Cloud Run Service Account
• Classifies assessment & visual evidence into canonical TaskType:
• Matches student method (Unit Form, Reciprocal, Common Denom, Vector)
• Selects domain-specific symbolic verifier & misconception taxonomy
• Normalizes handwritten fractions & signed integer expressions
• Maps visual number-line jumps or model partitions to algebraic steps
• Evaluates multi-part rubric completion (Parts A, B, C)
• Generates structured candidate hypotheses for symbolic checking
• Cross-checks diagnosis against raw Stage 1 visual observations
• Rejects unsupported claims; triggers bounded re-interpretation (max 1 retry)
• Computes alignment score & attaches CriticAuditResult to student record
• Evaluates work legibility, step completeness & model-verifier agreement
• If evidence is sparse/contradictory → forces Insufficient Evidence
• Sets needs_teacher_review = True to guarantee educator oversight
CohortIntelligenceAgent, Topic-Isolated Action Plans & Exit Tickets
• Public Access Prevention: Enforced (zero public object URLs)
• Access Control: Uniform Bucket-Level Access (IAM only via backend SA)
• Data Protection: Object Versioning enabled + 90-day retention lifecycle
• Content Integrity: Stores EXIF-stripped images keyed by assessment & UUID
• Local Dev uses LocalFilesystemStorage (data/uploads/); blocked in prod
• Connected via Cloud SQL Auth Proxy Unix Socket (/cloudsql/<conn>)
• Automated daily backups + Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) + Deletion Protection
Relational Schema & Core Entities (Tenant-Scoped by org_id)
• Records AI run, critic flag & HITL
• Atomic transactions when saving student diagnoses, teacher overrides & audits
• Teacher review updates immediately invalidate/recompute cohort aggregations
• Production fail-closed check prevents accidental container-local SQLite usage
• Local Dev Fallback: data/classlens.db (SQLite WAL mode)
• Structured JSON logs with X-Correlation-ID, stage latency & Gemini metadata
• Zero credential/PII logging enforced across all API & worker modules
5. Cloud Security, Secret Manager, Least-Privilege IAM & One-Command Terraform Deployment Pipeline
Google Secret Manager & Dedicated Service Accounts
✓ Mounted exclusively into classlens-backend at startup
✓ Never stored in Git, Terraform state plaintext, or images
✓ Zero secret exposure to Next.js client bundle
• Zero access to Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, or Secrets
• Immutable Git SHA image tags (sha-<git-commit>); :latest tag blocked in Terraform
• Automated cleanup policy retains recent production revisions for instant rollback
• Built for linux/amd64 with strict .dockerignore excluding .env, .git, and local DBs
